meta.title: BlueRoot, a proof registry for blue carbon
meta.description: Public registry of mangroves restored by communities in southern Benin: every hectare checked by satellite, in the field and by two validators, anchored on-chain.

home.tagline: Every root counts, so does every proof.
home.intro: BlueRoot is the public registry of mangroves restored by communities in southern Benin. A hectare only counts once it is proven by satellite, in the field and by two independent validators.
home.mapLabel: Map of the registry's mangrove zones on the coast of Benin
home.ledgerIntro: Every value is recomputed from on-chain events. One credit is 0.01 hectare-year of verified mangrove, not a tonne of CO2.
home.ledgerEmpty: No credit has been issued yet. The first credits will appear here once a file has received two validations.
home.flowTitle: How a mangrove becomes a credit
home.flowIntro: Eight steps, each leaving a verifiable trace. Gold marks what is anchored on-chain.

register.title: Zone registration
register.body: The proponent draws the zone; it becomes H3 cells reserved on-chain. A cell can belong to only one active project.

evidence.title: Field evidence
evidence.body: Agents send geotagged photos. The server checks position, date and duplicates, then stores them on private IPFS.

satellite.title: Satellite series
satellite.body: Sentinel-2 measures vegetation vigour (NDVI) over the project cells, month after month.

report.title: Advisory AI report
report.body: An AI cross-checks evidence and satellite data and flags inconsistencies. It decides nothing; its report is public.

anchor.title: Anchoring
anchor.body: The hash of the report and of the satellite series is written on-chain with the combined score.

validate.title: Two validators
validate.body: Two independent experts review the file and vote on that exact hash. Nobody validates their own project.

issue.title: Issuance
issue.body: Credits are issued; 20% go to a locked buffer pool against the risk of mangrove loss.

retire.title: Sale and retirement
retire.body: On every sale, at least 50% of the price goes to the community. A retired credit is destroyed and a public certificate is issued.

limits.carbon: NDVI measures vegetation vigour, not carbon. BlueRoot counts verified hectare-years, never certified tonnes of CO2.
limits.weights: The score weights (40% satellite, 40% field, 20% AI) and the threshold of 70 are demonstration assumptions, to be calibrated with experts.
limits.field: The demonstration zones are mangroves mapped in OpenStreetMap. Their status as projects must be validated in the field with the communities.

field.title: Field evidence
field.intro: Photograph the mangrove from inside the project zone. Every photo is checked: position, date and duplicates.

rules.private: Photos stay private. Only their fingerprint and the check results are published.
rules.offline: Without network, photos are kept on the phone and sent automatically when the network is back.
